transcription_english: [00:00:00.359] We not only went to the Tej and were called.
[00:00:04.080] We didn't just go to the tailgate and get called.
[00:00:08.549] No, we didn't even go to the Taj and were called.
[00:00:08.559] We did not just go to the tailgate or call us to our place with fingerprints.
[00:00:12.390] Not even with fingerprints can we replace ourselves.
[00:00:12.400] Not even fingerprints showed us where we were sitting, we showed us where we were sitting.
[00:00:17.910] Show us we showed us we were sitting right there.
[00:00:17.920] Show us we showed us we were sitting there we were sitting there we got cursed and they were on the table
[00:00:23.269] We were cursed and they were on the table.
[00:00:23.279] We were cursed and they stood on the table and told us our sorrows.
[00:00:28.109] Standing up and saying our sorrow is to us.
[00:00:28.119] Standing up and saying our sorrow is ours, our sorrow is ours, and it could not be theirs.
[00:00:32.790] Our sorrow was ours, and theirs could not be ours.
[00:00:32.800] Our sorrows could not be ours, and their sorrows could not be ours.
[00:00:38.030] Our sorrow could not have been ours alone.
[00:00:38.040] Our sorrow could not be our only sorrow, our suspicions could not be our only sorrow, we could explain our doubts.
[00:00:42.910] We cleared our doubts, and he stood up.
[00:00:42.920] We kind of eased our suspicions, and he kept his ear up and he kept his ear up and he kept his cool.
[00:00:47.470] He was listening with his ears up and cold.
[00:00:47.480] He was listening with his ears up and cold and filled with our own ears, holding us in breath.
[00:00:51.350] Filled with and holding our own ears, we breathed.
